lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: The Company had two customers in 2025 and 2024, respectively, that individually exceeded 10% of consolidated net sales.
Net sales to each of these two customers were approximately 13% of consolidated net sales in 2025 and 14% and 13% in 2024.
As of December 31, 2025, the Company had three customers each of which represented 10% or more of total trade receivables.
Accounts receivables from these three customers were approximately 17%, 13%, and 11% of consolidated accounts receivable.

As of December 31, 2024, the Company had three customers that individually represented 10% or more of total trade receivables, which accounted for 11%, 16%, and 15%, respectively, of total receivables.
The Company had two customers in 2025 and 2024, that individually exceeded 10% of consolidated net sales.
The Company had three customers in 2025 that individually exceeded 10% of consolidated accounts receivable.
Net sales to these two customers were approximately 13 % of consolidated net sales in 2025 and 14 % and 13 % in 2024.
We also rely upon third-party carriers for our product shipments from our distribution centers to customers.
Further, we rely on the ability to attract and retain labor on a cost-effective basis.
Our ability to attract and retain a sufficient workforce on a cost-effective basis depends on several factors.
The Company is a major supplier of products related to the “back-to-school” season, which occurs principally during the months of May through August.
Net sales and operating results are difficult to forecast, because they generally depend on the volume, timing and type of the orders we receive, all of which are uncertain.

The Company believes that its competitive position will depend on continued investment in innovation and product development, manufacturing and sourcing, quality standards, marketing and customer service and support.
Our ability to obtain additional financing, if and when required, will depend on investor demand, our operating performance, the condition of the capital markets and other factors.
Interruption to supplies from any of the Company’s vendors, or the loss of one or more key vendors, could have a negative effect on the Company’s business and operating results.

intro.text: ACME UNITED CORPORATION is a leading worldwide supplier of innovative safety solutions and cutting technology to the school, home, office, hardware, sporting goods and industrial markets. Its leading brands include First Aid Only ®, First Aid Central ®, Physicians Care ®, Pac-Kit®, Spill Magic ®, Westcott ®, Clauss ®, DMT ®, Med-Nap ®, Elite First Aid ® and My Medic ® .
